sections.title: Overview
descriptions: Officer Hope Nicole Groesbeck was employed by the American Fork Police Department from February 25, 2019, through June 26, 2024. She resigned before the department completed an internal affairs investigation into her sexual relationship with fellow Officer Jacob W. Hager, which included sexual activity while they were on duty.
The Utah POST Council suspended her peace officer certification for three and a half years.

sections.title: Employment
descriptions: Officer Hope Nicole Groesbeck began working for the American Fork Police Department on February 25, 2019. She resigned on June 26, 2024.

sections.title: POST Discipline
descriptions: According to the POST disciplinary proceedings, Hope Nicole Groesbeck had sexual intercourse with Officer Jacob W. Hager while on duty, in department vehicles in public locations. Both officers estimated that this occurred between 40 and 50 times during their sexual relationship, which lasted from October 2023 through June 2024.

Groesbeck resigned on June 26, 2024, before the investigation concluded. She did not attend the subsequent disciplinary hearing but was represented by counsel. The POST Council voted to suspend her peace officer certification for three and a half years.
